rationale: Second long-liquidation cascade since midnight ($56.7M longs vs $4.3K shorts, 06:20:55-06:47:58 COT) pushed price to a fresh session low of 85,440.8, about 115 points clear of the 85,325.2 reduce level - the closest that level has been tested all week. The midnight tranche (15 USDT at 86,393.2) explicitly earmarked the remaining ~19.5 USDT cash for a second buy only if the pullback extended into the 85,325.2-85,111.1 zone, or for a fresh settled reclaim of 86,632.6. Neither has printed: today's low (85,440.8) stayed above the add zone, and there has been no reclaim attempt. The 4H MACD histogram crossed negative for the first time this leg (27.58 to -83.21) while daily structure (price above every EMA, RSI 69.39) and the ETF inflow streak (4 days, 2.31B USD) stay intact - read as a second leg of the same healthy pullback rather than a trend change. Holding the existing tranche and stop rather than forcing a mid-range trade; letting the pre-set 85,325.2/86,632.6 triggers decide the next move.

message.text: Watch 85,325.2 - today's low (85,440.8) came within ~115 points, the closest all week. If midday sees a settled break, that's the trigger for the second DCA tranche flagged at midnight. If instead 86,632.6 gets a clean settled reclaim first, that's the alternate trigger. OI rose 1.30% through this session's flush (unlike midnight's pure deleveraging) - worth checking whether that's fresh shorts building or longs re-loading.
